name: NHS actin remodeling regulator

function.text: NHS is the approved symbol for NHS actin remodeling regulator. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in cell differentiation; lens development in camera-type eye.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Nance-Horan syndrome (x-linked). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Chronic lymphocytic leukemia; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; Definitive GenCC assertion, ClinGen. Allele-specific review required.
